cards.example_en: The family said a short prayer before Sunday dinner.

cards.example_en: A math tutor comes to our home on Wednesday evenings.
cards.example_zh: 一位数学导师每周三晚上来我们家。

cards.example_en: Mum will insist on warm coats in this cold wind.
cards.example_zh: 风这么冷，妈妈一定会坚持让我们穿厚外套。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：侵略的
cards.example_en: The history book described an aggressive attack on the island.
cards.example_zh: 历史书描述了对那座岛的侵略性进攻。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：合理地
cards.example_en: The shop priced the pen reasonably.
cards.example_zh: 这家店给钢笔定的价格还算合理。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：愚蠢的
cards.example_en: Wearing socks on your hands looks silly at the party.
cards.example_zh: 在聚会上把袜子套在手上，看起来很傻。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Iron is the element that makes blood able to carry oxygen.
cards.example_zh: 铁这种元素让血液能够携带氧气。

cards.example_en: The establishment of a lunchtime choir gave shy students a place to sing.
cards.example_zh: 午间合唱团建立之后，害羞的学生有了唱歌的地方。

cards.example_zh: 我们的实验表明，植物在向阳的窗边长得更快。

cards.example_en: Parent involvement made the sports day run more smoothly.
cards.example_zh: 家长的参与让运动会进行得更顺利。

cards.example_en: The poster raised awareness about saving water at home.
cards.example_zh: 这张海报让大家更注意在家里节约用水。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The parents' association organised the spring fair.
cards.example_zh: 家长协会组织了春季义卖。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: My intention was to return the book before the library closed.
cards.example_zh: 我的用意是在图书馆关门前把书还回去。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: His absence from choir practice worried the music teacher.
cards.example_zh: 他没来参加合唱排练，音乐老师很担心。
